pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside demand is SEO article ranking, keyword strategy, FAQ coverage, and outranking competitor content. This seed adapts that need into a deterministic offline browser board where a user compares a competitor article angle with their own idea, sorts gap cards by search promise, evidence, FAQ coverage, originality, and action priority, then copies/exports a content-gap brief. It is not an AI writer and does not call any hosted AI, APIs, CDN assets, or remote fonts.
